TN Cracks Down on Liquor Overpricing, Issues New Rules

The Tamil Nadu government has issued new rules to crack down on liquor overpricing. The move comes after the state cracked down on liquor overpricing in recent days. The government said it would suspend licenses of TASMACs that fail to comply with the new rules. Repeat offenders will face dismissal. ThePrint reported that the government had set a deadline for TASMACs to implement the new rules. Deccan Herald stated that repeat offenders would be dismissed from their jobs. Daily Pioneer echoed the government's stance on the issue. Deccan Chronicle mentioned that suspension and depot work were among the penalties for non-compliance.
